name: Stirling Moss
context: TT winner at Dundrod in 1950, 1951 and 1955. His first win came in Tommy Wisdom's XK120 on the eve of his twenty-first birthday; the last came with John Fitch in Mercedes-Benz's 300 SLR.

name: Peter Whitehead
context: Won the 1950 Ulster Trophy in a Ferrari 125 — the first race meeting on the new circuit.

name: Anthony Powys-Lybbe
context: Won the handicap contest at the opening August 1950 meeting in an Alfa Romeo P3.

name: Giuseppe Farina
context: The reigning Formula One World Champion won the 1951 Ulster Trophy in an Alfa Romeo 159 and set a 4:44 lap record.

name: Piero Taruffi
context: Won the 1952 Ulster Trophy in a Vandervell-entered Ferrari 375.

name: Mike Hawthorn
context: Second in the 1952 Ulster Trophy in a Cooper-Bristol; won the 1953 Ulster Trophy and the 1954 TT scratch result; shared Jaguar's works D-Type with Titterington in 1955 and set the 4:42 lap record.

name: Juan Manuel Fangio
context: Appeared with Moss in the experimental V16 BRM at the 1952 Ulster Trophy; neither finished.

name: Peter Collins
context: Won the 1953 RAC TT with Pat Griffith in an Aston Martin DB3S.

name: Pat Griffith
context: Won the 1953 RAC TT with Peter Collins in an Aston Martin DB3S.

name: Maurice Trintignant
context: Shared the 1954 TT scratch and championship result with Mike Hawthorn in a Ferrari 750 Monza.

name: Gérard Laureau
context: With Paul Armagnac, took the 1954 Tourist Trophy under the handicap classification in a small DB-Panhard.

name: Paul Armagnac
context: With Gérard Laureau, took the 1954 Tourist Trophy under the handicap classification in a small DB-Panhard.

name: Desmond Titterington
context: Local driver from Holywood. Fastest finisher in the 1955 Ulster Trophy handicap, and shared the factory Jaguar D-Type with Hawthorn in the 1955 TT.

name: Bill Smith
context: Won the handicap Champion Trophy at the May 1955 Ulster Trophy meeting in a Jaguar C-Type.

name: John Fitch
context: Shared Moss's winning Mercedes-Benz 300 SLR in the 1955 TT.

name: Jim Mayers
context: Died in the multi-car crash at Deer's Leap on the second lap of the 1955 TT.

name: William Smith
context: Died in the multi-car crash at Deer's Leap on the second lap of the 1955 TT.

name: Richard Mainwaring
context: Died when his Elva crashed at Tornagrough during the 1955 TT.

name: Eric Winterbottom
context: Died in a first-lap crash at the 1951 Tourist Trophy.

name: Raymond Mays
context: Pictured with the BRM team around the V16 at the 1952 Ulster Trophy.

name: Alfred Neubauer
context: Mercedes team manager, pictured with Stirling Moss at Dundrod in 1955.
